# 2 Samuel 15 — Disagreement Log
**Chapter:** 2 Samuel 15 (37 verses)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA
**Total disagreements logged:** 11

---

## V.1 — "provided for himself" vs. "made for himself" vs. "got himself"
- **EMET:** "made for-himself"
- **LOGOS:** "provided for himself"
- **PNEUMA:** "got himself"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "provided for himself" — captures the deliberate, preparatory nature of *vaya'as lo*.

---

## V.3 — "a hearer there is not" vs. "no one appointed"
- **EMET:** "a-hearer there-is-not to-you from the-king"
- **LOGOS:** "no one appointed by the king to hear you"
- **PNEUMA:** "the king hasn't appointed anyone to hear cases like yours"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "no one appointed by the king to hear you" — clarifies the Hebrew idiom in formal register.

---

## V.7 — "forty years" vs. "four years"
- **EMET:** "forty years" (follows LC, notes likely error)
- **LOGOS/PNEUMA:** "four years"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "four years" — MT's "forty" is a chronological impossibility; Syriac, LXX MSS, and Josephus all support "four."

---

## V.10 — "spies" vs. "secret messengers" vs. "agents"
- **EMET:** "spies [meragelim]"
- **LOGOS:** "secret messengers"
- **PNEUMA:** "agents"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "secret messengers" — captures the covert communication function rather than surveillance.

---

## V.14 — "drive upon us the evil" vs. "bring down ruin" vs. "bring disaster"
- **EMET:** "drive-upon-us the-evil"
- **LOGOS:** "bring down ruin upon us"
- **PNEUMA:** "bring disaster on us"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "bring down ruin upon us" — greater force and weight than PNEUMA's "bring disaster."

---

## V.19-20 — "I am going where I am going" vs. "I go I know not where"
- **EMET:** "I [am]-going where I [am]-going"
- **LOGOS:** "I go I know not where"
- **PNEUMA:** "I don't even know where I'm going"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "I go I know not where" — preserves the resigned uncertainty with appropriate gravitas.

---

## V.20 — "covenant-faithfulness" vs. "faithful love"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "covenant-faithfulness"
- **PNEUMA:** "faithful love"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "covenant-faithfulness" — follows project convention for *chesed*.

---

## V.23 — "wadi" vs. "brook" vs. "valley"
- **EMET:** "wadi of Qidron"
- **LOGOS:** "brook Kidron"
- **PNEUMA:** "Kidron Valley"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "brook Kidron" — traditional English rendering of *nachal Qidron*.

---

## V.26 — "no delight" vs. "no pleasure"
- **EMET/LOGOS:** "no delight"
- **PNEUMA:** "no pleasure"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "no delight" — preserves the starkness of *lo chafatsti*.

---

## V.28 — "plains" vs. "fords" vs. "river crossings"
- **EMET:** "plains of the wilderness"
- **LOGOS:** "fords of the wilderness"
- **PNEUMA:** "river crossings in the wilderness"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "fords of the wilderness" — reflects David's strategic positioning at crossing points.

---

## V.31 — "make foolish" vs. "turn into foolishness" vs. "turn into nonsense"
- **EMET:** "Make-foolish, please"
- **LOGOS:** "please turn... into foolishness"
- **PNEUMA:** "turn... into nonsense"
- **SOPHIA ruling:** "please turn the counsel of Ahithophel into foolishness" — preserves the *na* (please) and gravity of the prayer.

---
*— SOPHIA*
